text: This bottle was at sea for a hundred and eight years.
Scientists threw in one thousand and twenty of them. On purpose.
Each was weighted to drift near the seabed, to track deep currents.
Whoever found one mailed back the postcard, for one shilling.
About half came back. But one kept drifting, until 2015.
It washed up in Germany. And the shilling? They paid it.
What would you write in yours?
